operational_failures.failed_witness: The first programmatic x1 domain-patch composition failed in JavaScript because unescaped Markdown backticks terminated its template literal.
operational_failures.recovery: Removed display-only backticks from the generated prose and reran the atomically failed patch composition.
operational_failures.recurrence_guard: Escape or omit Markdown backticks inside JavaScript template literals used to compose patches.

operational_failures.failed_witness: A later x1 overview patch was atomically rejected because one expected count line did not exactly match the live wrapped text.
operational_failures.recovery: Read the exact bounded line region and applied only the verified hunks.
operational_failures.recurrence_guard: Inspect exact live wrapping before patching long generated prose.

operational_failures.failed_witness: The first human-readable novelty-diagnostic display truncated before all sixty neighbour records were attributable.
operational_failures.recovery: Projected only path count record count maximum score exact count quarantine count and review count from the complete file.
operational_failures.recurrence_guard: Use compact scalar projections for large neighbour ledgers after preserving the full file.

operational_failures.failed_witness: The first core-module patch expected an already-updated dotted schema version and was atomically rejected against the exact copied source.
operational_failures.recovery: Inspected exact core constants and patched the role digest and dotted schema against verified lines.
operational_failures.recurrence_guard: Check hyphenated and dotted version spellings independently after mechanical remastering.

operational_failures.failed_witness: A double-quoted PowerShell ripgrep pattern exposed its pipe characters to the shell and triggered module parsing instead of a bounded search.
operational_failures.recovery: Repeated only the search with the complete regular expression in single quotes.
operational_failures.recurrence_guard: Single-quote literal regular expressions containing shell metacharacters on PowerShell.

operational_failures.failed_witness: The first runner inventory assumed forward-slash rg output on Windows and falsely projected zero runner files.
operational_failures.recovery: Repeated only the inventory with a separator-independent lighthouse runner basename expression and found all ten files.
operational_failures.recurrence_guard: Normalize path separators or match basenames when projecting cross-platform file inventories.

operational_failures.failed_witness: The first exact staged diff-hygiene check rejected one extra blank line at EOF in the x2 builder and core module.
operational_failures.recovery: Removed only the two trailing blank lines and reran the failed diff-hygiene dependency.
operational_failures.recurrence_guard: Normalize generated source endings to exactly one terminal newline before staging.

operational_failures.failed_witness: The exact staged pytest wrapper completed without a surviving attributable result because its presentation exceeded the model-visible output context.
operational_failures.recovery: Confirmed that no matching test process remained and invoked only the same owner-local test module through the concise direct unittest entry point.
operational_failures.recurrence_guard: Use a concise module-local test entry point when a wrapper presentation becomes opaque and retain the opaque wrapper as zero-credit evidence.
